opening.quote: Good morning, Tidewell Home, my name is Femke. How can I help today?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, as the scorecard requires.

verification.quote: Can I take your full name and the order number or postcode?
verification.comment: You asked for the full name and postcode before discussing the payment, which is correct; the caller gave both.

understanding.quote: So you've disputed that payment with your bank and want to know the next step?
understanding.comment: You captured the issue accurately and did not ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Your bank will contact you with their decision.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The policy gives no timeline for the bank, and you did not invent one, but you also did not mention that the Payments team handles disputes and replies within 2 working days, so the caller was left without the correct next step.

process_compliance.quote: I'll make a note on your order that you've opened a dispute. Your bank will contact you with their decision.
process_compliance.comment: Bank disputes must be passed to the Payments team, not handled by the agent, and you instead added a note and told the caller to wait, so the required referral was missed.

communication.quote: Thanks for letting me know, and I'm sorry you had to go to your bank over this.
communication.comment: You were polite throughout and acknowledged the caller's situation with an apology.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: You confirmed a follow-up email and asked if anything else was needed before closing politely, though the email promise did not state what it would contain.
